items.label: text
items.text: Ancient travellers would construct a basic compass byplacing a splinter (thinpiece)of magnetisedrockcalled lodestone onto apieceofwoodfloating in water.The splinter would tum to point in the direction ofnorth-south. The end pointing towards the north was called thenorth pole.
